It is not a transmitted text of the poem. The papyrus text Campbell prints (Hebrus, Aenus, the girls bathing) is not in Edmonds. Edmonds' vol. Alcman 3 (Ὀλ]υμπιάδες περί με φρένας ..., Astymeloisa) is P.Oxy. 2387, first published 1957; none of its lines is quoted by an ancient author, so it is absent from Edmonds, Lyra Graeca I (1922) (searched the OCR for Astymeloisa, limb-loosening, melting, and the Greek forms) and from every other pre-1930 translation. No public-domain English translation exists.
